introHtml: Running events, marathons, and fun runs are all about energy and motion. Custom running stress relievers balls give participants a tangible reminder of the experience, whether shaped like a sneaker or printed with your race logo. These soft, squeezable items are easy to toss in a swag bag or hand out at the finish line. Choose vibrant colors that match your event branding, and add your team name or sponsor logo for a keepsake that runners will actually use during warm-ups or cooldowns.
